messages:
lina_support: hey team — cust_jansen reports embeddings suddenly switched shape after our reserved/pinned model rollout yesterday. they expect 1536 but getting 768. happened ~22:05 UTC during the maintenance window.

cust_jansen: yep — pipeline started failing when we bulk-insert to our vector DB. only change on our side was using the pinned model id recommended by your ops team. sample response attached below.

lina_support: sample payload from the customer (redacted keys):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-1536@pinned-2026-03-16","input":["text a","text b","text c"]}'
```
response snippet: `{"data":[{"embedding":[0.001,-0.02,...],"index":0}],"model":"open-embed-1536@pinned-2026-03-16"}` — but embedding length = 768 when we count.

matt_eng: can you paste the raw byte length or token count? also include `x-redwood-variant` if present. sometimes aliasing maps to a compatibility variant.

lina_support: header the customer sent: `x-redwood-variant: quant-8bit-lc`, `x-region: us-west-2`, model header matches pinned id.

raj_ml: quick theory — the pinned alias might have been pointed at a 768-subfamily by mistake (e.g., open-embed-768-v1) while keeping the 1536 alias name. quantized variants can also carry inherent shape differences if the wrong model file is bound. this would explain same model name but different vector length.

sophia_ops: deploy-bot logs show a reserved lock/swap on `open-embed-1536:v2-pin` during the window:
```
deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-16T21:50 UTC -> 20% traffic
deploy-bot: complete -> 100% traffic 2026-03-16T22:00 UTC
reserved-lock: applied to pool-rc-3
```

deploy-bot: [info] Canary rollout completed. No automatic rollback triggered.

matt_eng: steps to reproduce locally (suggested):
1) call embeddings with pinned model id and `x-redwood-variant: quant-8bit-lc`
2) try batch sizes [1,8,64] to see if batching layer concatenates mixed-dim outputs
3) test same model id with `x-redwood-variant: float16` to compare dims

```python
# minimal repro
import requests
h={'Authorization':'Bearer REDACTED','Content-Type':'application/json','x-redwood-variant':'quant-8bit-lc'}
data={"model":"open-embed-1536@pinned-2026-03-16","input":["a"]}
r=requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings',json=data,headers=h)
print(len(r.json()['data'][0]['embedding']))
```

raj_ml: if local repro returns 1536 consistently but customer sees 768, check edge cache / regional routing — maybe the reserved pool in us-west-2 is serving a different model artifact. also check model registry entries for recent pointer changes (audit logs).

sophia_ops: I pulled the registry audit: there was an update 2026-03-16T21:45 by deploy-ci -> changed pointer for `open-embed-1536@pinned-2026-03-16` -> new target id `open-embed-768-compat:2026-03-16` (looks like a tagging mistake). raising a Sev2.

lina_support: cc @eng-oncall — customer impact: bulk uploader failing, rate-limited retries spiking. customer requests immediate fallback to previous artifact.

eng-oncall: acknowledged — will coordinate rollback. quick mitigation: set override header `x-redwood-force-artifact: open-embed-1536-v2-fp16` for the customer until we roll back the pinned alias. please share customer account id and example request id.

matt_eng: follow-up: runtime batching could hide the mismatch if different backends are mixed in the same batch — we should disable multi-backend batching for pinned/reserved pools until artifact pointer verified. filing infra ticket.

cust_jansen: thanks — we can add the override header suggested. please let us know ETA on alias rollback; this is blocking nightly indexing (~3M rows).

lina_support: action items:
- ops: rollback pointer for `open-embed-1536@pinned-2026-03-16` to artifact `open-embed-1536-v2-fp16` (sophia)
- eng: disable cross-backend batching for reserved pools until pointer confirmed (matt)
- ml: audit model registry and add pre-rollout shape check to canary (raj)
- support: share override header and temporary guidance to customer (lina)

sophia_ops: rollback scheduled now; will confirm when done.

deploy-bot: rollback job started 2026-03-17T00:10 UTC -> target `open-embed-1536-v2-fp16`

lina_support: thx all — keeping thread open until customer confirms their ingest back to normal. :white_check_mark:
